blocks_element.text: For every 2 fl. oz. of water, add one unpacked, level scoop of Bobbie. You can tap the scoop on the side of the can to knock off any extra powder, or use a clean knife to level it off. Use the scoop that comes in the Bobbie can of formula.

blocks_element.repere: Point · Pop the scoop back in the can and put …
blocks_element.text: Pop the scoop back in the can and put the lid on.

blocks_element.repere: Point · Cap the bottle and shake gently until …
blocks_element.text: Cap the bottle and shake gently until the powder is fully dissolved.

blocks_element.repere: Point · Bobbie is designed for safe, everyday …

Bobbie is designed for safe, everyday feeding when prepared as directed. Use prepared formula within 2 hours, and once feeding has started, discard any unfinished bottle after 1 hour. Heads up: don't refrigerate leftover formula to save for later.

Compared to other carb sources sometimes found in formula—like corn syrup solids or sucrose —lactose has a less sweet taste, and provides a natural source of sustained energy that is closer to breast milk.
